result_text:
I fixed the four broken default conventions in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventions.java`. The new regression test and the existing `SourceFileFilterTest` pass offline (4 and 6 tests, no failures). I did not commit.

- **Generated HTML (pkgdown, Doxygen, meta generator):** the path pattern was `(html|html|xhtml)`, now `(htm|html|xhtml)`. This covers all three rules.
- **.NET doc XML:** `.*/[.]xml` became `.*[.]xml`, so `MyAssembly.xml` matches.
- **JS "// Generated by":** `.*/[.]js` became `.*[.]js`, so `app.js` matches.
- **Gradle JS:** `.*[.][-]gradle[.]js` became `.*[-]gradle[.]js`, so `build-gradle.js` matches.

I also added `codeanalyzer/src/test/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventionsTest.java`. It checks that `.htm` pages with each generator marker land in the generated scope, that `.xhtml` and Doxygen `.html` still match, that `MyAssembly.xml` and `app.js` match, that `build-gradle.js` and `build.gradle` are build-and-deployment, and that hand-written `.htm`, `.js` and `.xml` files stay out. I did not run the new test against the original patterns to confirm it fails there.
